author: Veronica Underwood
body: I do not have enough good things to say about the sleep plan, the Instagram account, the Facebook group, and Andrea in general! This was a total lifesaver. I discovered Baby Sleep Answers when my first was about 6 months old. She had been a chronic short napper and had multiple wake-up’s during the night. When I was pregnant, all my research went into baby sleep so I felt prepared when my daughter was born and knew exactly what to do…..until none of it worked! After 6 months of no sleep I knew I had to do something. But as a first time mom, none of the popular sleep training programs out there made me feel comfortable. That is when I found Baby Sleep Answers on Instagram. I love how real Andrea is! She made me feel comfortable and ready to begin the sleep training process. She offered different methods depending on how gentle you want to the approach to be and let’s you just work on what isn’t sustainable for you anymore, while keeping what does work. We started to tackle the middle of the night wake ups first. I still fed to sleep/almost to sleep at bedtime but was able to get rid of the night wakes within a few weeks! It was AMAZING!! My daughter ended up wanting to put herself to sleep on her own. She is now 14 months old and is a great sleeper! I cannot recommend the sleep plan enough. To say it was life changing is an understatement! I also LOVE the private Facebook group that you get with the plan. I have used it so many times when we’ve had a weird situation and I need some real time advice! Overall 11/10!
